metaTitle: Custom Adjustable Embroidered Patches | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom adjustable embroidered patches with hook-and-loop backing. Perfect for uniforms, teams, and bulk branding at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom adjustable embroidered patches with hook-and-loop backing let you swap or reposition patches on uniforms, bags, and hats without sewing. Ideal for teams with rotating rosters, seasonal staff, or multi-department use, these patches offer flexibility that sewn-on patches can't match. Choose from edge-stitched or merrowed borders in any shape, and add your logo or text in up to 12 thread colors. Perfect for safety vests, polo shirts, and backpacks where a clean, professional look matters.
heroAltText: Custom adjustable embroidered patches with hook-and-loop backing on a uniform sleeve
